title: FabrChatDisabling
description: A client-side fabric mod that allows you to turn off certain chat features!
body:
This mod adds a way to turn off certain chat features! It is perfect for disabling chat for eg: popular servers with people spamming chat!

The Icon appears in the pause menu and it is to the right of the "Back to game" button. Upon opening the menu you will get a menu with all 5 options: chat (normal chat messages), commands (command broadcasts and any related messages), death (death messages), join (join messages), leave (leave messages)

DISCLAIMER: IT DOES NOT WORK ON SERVERS THAT DO SOMETHING TO CHAT OR HAVE THEIR OWN CHAT SYSTEM LIKE MINEMEN FOR EXAMPLE!!!
